name: nest-l-brackets
description: Twenty L-shaped shelf brackets, 500mm x 500mm with a 300mm x 300mm notch, cut on a CNC router. Each bracket is 160,000 sq mm of material inside a 250,000 sq mm box, so a table saw throws away 36% of every one before it starts - it fits 4 across and 2 down per sheet at a 3mm kerf, 8 per sheet, three sheets for twenty. A router can drop a turned bracket into another's notch, which is what the fixture measures. Hand-checked: 8 boxes per sheet on a saw, against a theoretical ceiling of 18 brackets per sheet by area alone.
